brief:
Human rights activist Hind Rajab has filed a complaint with the International Criminal Court against the Israeli Medical Association, alleging involvement in the torture of Palestinian prisoners, Shehab Wire reported. The complaint centers on the association's alleged role in systematic abuse of detainees.

Rajab's filing represents an effort to hold professional medical bodies accountable for practices related to prisoner treatment in Israeli custody. The submission comes amid ongoing documentation of alleged abuse allegations involving Palestinian detainees.

title: Palestinian activist files ICC complaint against Israeli medical association over prisoner torture
